title: ADR archive metadata

drift.summary: The archive is intentionally historical and remains reliable when read as decision history rather than current feature docs.
rationale: Historical ADRs should not be judged as stale merely because implementation moved on.
The archive still explains why key constraints exist.
Current-state claims should live in domain or architecture pages.
